scientific_question: How does the study detector compare with an established, independently maintained 3D medical object-detection framework under the same case partitions and evaluation endpoint?

selected_framework.name: MONAI 3D RetinaNet / RetinaNetDetector
selected_framework.reason: Official MONAI provides 2D/3D RetinaNet detection components and a maintained LUNA16 3D detection tutorial; MONAI 1.6.0 is compatible with the modern PyTorch/CUDA environment and avoids the legacy PyTorch-1.x constraint of nnDetection.
selected_framework.not_claimed_as: nnDetection or a reproduction of nnDetection

data_contract.input: same 0.5-mm isotropic preprocessed volumes used by the canonical physical-space pipeline

anchor_contract.selection_data: optimization boxes only within each fold
anchor_contract.procedure: derive three base anchor shapes deterministically from the component-wise 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles of optimization-box extents on the 0.5-mm resampled voxel grid; round each dimension to the nearest positive integer >= 2
anchor_contract.feature_map_scales: powers of two across returned FPN levels

training_contract.formal_seed_schedule: same repeat/fold seed schedule used for the paired revision experiments
training_contract.training_budget: 30 epochs x 96 optimizer steps per epoch
training_contract.learning_rate: fixed before formal runs after implementation smoke only; default starting candidate 0.01; any change requires a pre-performance protocol amendment and cannot use formal validation results
training_contract.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation pFROC under the manuscript evaluator; exact ties retain earlier epoch
training_contract.normalization: labeled optimization cases only, using the same percentile normalization formula as the canonical pure-supervised benchmark
training_contract.augmentation: minimal geometry-preserving training augmentation; no test-set-derived tuning

evaluation_contract.primary_endpoint: validation pFROC at FP/volume budgets 0.5, 1, 2, 4 using the manuscript matching/evaluation code
evaluation_contract.calibration_and_outer_test: not required for the primary reviewer response
evaluation_contract.comparison: MONAI RetinaNet3D is reported alongside the existing internal Conventional3D and Mean-Teacher3D controls; it does not replace them

smoke_test_policy.scope: one fold, one seed, <= 2 epochs / small step count, execution-only
smoke_test_policy.allowed_changes_after_smoke: implementation fixes, tensor-shape fixes, memory-safety fixes, and one learning-rate feasibility amendment before formal results are viewed

failure_policy: retain formal failures; no performance-based deletion or hyperparameter rescue after formal results begin
claim_rule: Use this experiment only to benchmark against an established external detector implementation. Do not claim state of the art from a single framework comparison.
